title: Encoded machine relation
statement: Let $\mathrm{orc}$ be a function from four deciders and Boolean words to truth values, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $s,u,v$ be natural numbers. Define $u$ to be related to $v$ (with parameter $s$ and input $x$) exactly when decider number $3$ accepts the encoding of $x$, the canonical binary expansions of $u$ and $v$, and the canonical binary expansion of $s$, nested as a sequence of pairs.
hypotheses_covered: Function from four deciders and Boolean words to truth values
